full_judgment: This Rule arises out of an order of the learned Munsif, Cox's Bazar dismissing the Miscellaneous Case No. 81 of 1983 filed under Order 9, Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure by the petitioner for setting aside an ex-parte order dated 10.4.1982 made in the Miscellaneous case No. 342 filed under section 96 of the Slate Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for pre-empting certain land.
